papers.title: Midterm Results Of Total Hip Arthroplasty (THA) In Developmental Dysplasia Of The Hip (DDH)
papers.abstract: Objectives Total hip arthroplasty (THA) in developmental dysplasia of the hip (DDH) is a challenging procedure. We analysed 51 patients with this condition. The focus of this article is to provide our experience; the results and complications of THA in DDH.
papers.venue: The Internet Journal of Orthopedic Surgery

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文仅报告发育性髋关节发育不良全髋关节置换术的临床结果，没有涉及任何生物力学建模或有限元分析。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not quantify stress shielding or micromotion, no FEA modeling, no contact mechanics, and no comparison of intact vs implanted femur.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估发育性髋关节发育不良患者全髋置换术的中期效果与并发症。
summary_zh.method: 回顾性分析51例DDH患者THA的临床资料与随访结果。
summary_zh.result: THA在DDH中效果可接受，但并发症发生率较高。
summary_zh.validation: 基于51例患者的临床随访数据。

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate the midterm clinical outcomes and complications of total hip arthroplasty in patients with developmental dysplasia of the hip.
summary_en.method: A retrospective analysis of 51 DDH patients who underwent THA, with clinical and radiographic follow-up.
summary_en.result: THA in DDH yields acceptable functional outcomes but a notable complication rate.
summary_en.validation: Clinical validation through patient follow-up and complication recording.
